data.name: Achhelal
data.gender_notes: Achhelal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Achhela', which means 'Lord Achela'. Achela is a deity revered in Hindu mythology and is believed to bring good luck and prosperity. The name Achhelal carries the meaning “Lord Achela's” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Achhelal usually hope their child will grow to embody lord achela's and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Achhelal" carries a rich cultural significance in Hinduism as it is associated with the revered deity 'Achela'. This name has been passed down through generations and is considered an auspicious name, indicating good fortune and blessings from the Lord.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Achhelal" holds deep spiritual significance, as the name itself is a tribute to Lord Achela. It is believed that invoking the name of this deity brings good luck, prosperity, and protection. On a personal level, bearing this name is said to symbolize a deep connection to the divine and a strong spiritual foundation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Achhelal: The radiant one, who illuminates the path to wisdom and spiritual growth through the flame of self-realization.

historical_references.reference: Achhelal was a powerful Rajput king of the Chauhan dynasty reigning over the area of Alwar in present-day Rajasthan, India. He is mentioned in the epics of Rajput kings, particularly in the Prithviraj Raso, which chronicles the life and times of Prithviraj Chauhan.

Another reference to Achhelal comes from the Puranas, an ancient collection of Hindu religious texts. In this context, Achhelal is described as a powerful Yaksha (a class of nature deities) who protected the sacred forest of Khandava in the Mahabharata epic.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Achhelal' is of Hindu origin and translates to 'the immortal one'. In today's modern context, this name is often associated with spirituality, yoga, and Ayurveda practices. On Instagram, there are numerous accounts dedicated to sharing images and videos of yoga poses and spiritual practices with the name 'Achhelal' in the caption or hashtag. Pinterest boards also feature 'Achhelal' in the title of boards related to Hindu spirituality, yoga, and Ayurveda. Blogs and websites, particularly those focused on Indian culture and spirituality, may also use the name in articles and titles related to these topics.
